measurementContract.directClock: supervisor; actual RPC prompt start to first visible text_delta / agent_settled
measurementContract.uiClock: browser; actual native click timestamp to MutationObserver visible processing/reply
measurementContract.timeoutPolicy: Record failure and stop batch; do not resend ambiguous input or substitute success
measurementContract.modelStartMeaning: Pi before_provider_request, not provider internal processing
measurementContract.calibration: minimum RTT bound from >=10 raw samples; source/browser each to same supervisor; before and after files never overwrite
measurementContract.traceOverhead: primary synchronous encode/write/fsync separately measured; secondary log and fault-config read excluded; no cost subtraction

cleanupScope: Only this harness-owned Pi ChildProcess and explicitly supplied benchmark browser owned by anchors; never identify ownership by port alone
